worth.words: Rebuilt for 2025 and 2026 weeks 1–4 with the cornerback counting (the rule until this week), listed players scored above their projection in 15 of 38 games (40%; everyone else at the position 35%) and finished 0.7 points better than everyone else against it (−1.1 to +2.6) — not distinguishable from chance.
